units.source_text: 乍一看，他们的追迹很笨拙，实则是把他往海里赶，其实很有计划。

en.t: At first glance, their pursuit seemed clumsy, but in fact they were driving him toward the sea, and it was actually very carefully planned.

units.source_text: 他不知不觉之中被他们诱导了。

en.t: Without realizing it, he had been led along by them.

units.source_text: 仔细一想，就连那个手电筒，看来也是故意告诉别人自己位置的。

en.t: Thinking it over carefully, even that flashlight seemed to have been meant to deliberately reveal his position to others.

units.source_text: 他们不即不离，始终保持这个距离，恐怕是经过计算的吧。

en.t: They kept neither too close nor too far away, maintaining that distance the whole time; it was probably calculated.
